findings.message: The artifact marks AC-001 through AC-003 and REQ-005 verified from a passing run, but does not establish the planned Playwright browser verification. In particular, AC-002 requires a Playwright test that verifies the circle's center and radius; the listed test title only says it accepts/replaces the expression, while the pinned implementation summary describes Vitest coverage. The report therefore does not demonstrate the required test or geometry result and cannot support these verified claims.
